author: iFixit
description:
Google’s Pixel Watch 5 may be the most repairable mainstream smartwatch on the market—and it isn’t even close.
In this teardown, we open the 45 mm Pixel Watch 5 to examine its latch-and-O-ring construction, removable battery, replaceable display, upgraded internal hardware, and subtle repair-friendly improvements. We also compare it with the Pixel Watch 4 and explain why Google’s design earns a provisional 9 out of 10 on our smartwatch repairability scale.
Highlights include a 465 mAh battery, color-coded repair screws, replaceable sealing gaskets, 64 GB of storage, 3 GB of memory, and Google’s upgraded Snapdragon wearable platform.
This teardown is an educational look inside the device, not a repair guide. If you’re repairing a Pixel Watch 5, follow the complete step-by-step guide:
